bugs.title: Document Builder has no secondary brand color control
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Document Builder.
Inspect Theme Settings and all available controls.
Try to configure distinct primary and secondary brand colors.
bugs.expected: The document theme supports both primary and secondary brand colors.
bugs.actual: Only a Primary Color input is present. There is no Secondary Color field or selector.
bugs.comment: Add secondary color configuration, persistence, preview and document application. Primary-color persistence is independently tested; logo selection is available in Settings and is not assumed missing.

bugs.title: Saved document theme updates Builder preview but is ignored by actual invoices
steps: In Document Builder, set primary color #17675e, Classic style and Roboto font; save.
Reload Builder and confirm the saved color/style/font remain.
Create a fresh Rs 100 QA service cash sale for QA Billing Automation Customer.
Open that exact sale's formal invoice through its actual /app/invoicing/<id> document.
Compare the invoice appearance to the saved theme and live preview.
bugs.expected: The generated invoice uses the saved document theme, including its selected primary branding color.
bugs.actual: Builder save/readback and live preview use #17675e, but the actual new invoice retains its fixed appearance. No document element uses the saved primary color. The deployed Invoice Details component reads the older invoice header/footer settings and does not consume the document-template query.
bugs.comment: Connect actual document rendering to the persisted template configuration, then retest invoices, quotations and receipt output as applicable. Preserve saved content/branding and verify the exported document after RET-002 is repaired. All temporary template changes were restored.
